claim: Singapore Botanic Gardens is free to enter; only the National Orchid Garden is ticketed, open daily 08:30–19:00 with last entry 18:00.
quote: The National Orchid Garden opening hours are daily from 8:30 AM to 7 PM. The last entry to the National Orchid Garden and its attractions is at 6 PM, daily.

claim: National Orchid Garden 2026 admission is SGD 15 for foreign adults, SGD 5 for local adults, SGD 1 for local students/seniors, and free for children under 12.
quote: Adults: SGD 5.00; Students: SGD 1.00; Senior citizens (60 years and above): SGD 1.00; Children below 12 years: FREE ... Foreign adults: S$15

claim: Rainforest Wild Asia is Mandai's newest adventure-based wildlife park with limited daily capacity; pre-booking is strongly recommended as same-day tickets can sell out by mid-morning on weekends and holidays.
quote: Rainforest Wild Asia is one of Mandai's newest and most in-demand attractions with limited daily capacity, and pre-booking online is highly recommended, especially on weekends, holidays, and school breaks, as same-day tickets may sell out by mid-morning.

claim: A Mandai multi-attraction bundle is SGD 128 for adults (usual price SGD 246), covering Night Safari plus one choice of Singapore Zoo, River Wonders, Bird Paradise or Rainforest Wild Adventure.
quote: a multi-attraction bundle is available at S$128 for adults (U.P. S$246), which includes Night Safari and a choice of Singapore Zoo, River Wonders, Bird Paradise OR Rainforest Wild Adventure

claim: Singapore Zoo single-park adult admission is SGD 48 and Night Safari from SGD 53 in 2026.
quote: Night Safari: Adult tickets start at SGD 53 ... Singapore Zoo: SGD 48 for adults

claim: The MacRitchie TreeTop Walk is open Tuesday–Friday 09:00–17:00 and from 08:30 on weekends (closed Mondays), with last entry at 16:45.
quote: The TreeTop Walk is open from 9am to 5pm on Tuesdays to Fridays and from 8.30am on weekends (closed on Mondays); the last entry is at 4.45pm.

claim: The MacRitchie TreeTop suspension bridge spans 250m connecting Bukit Peirce and Bukit Kalang, reached via a 4.5km walk from the Lornie Road entrance (1–2 hours one way) on the broader 11km nature trail.
quote: The TreeTop Walk spans approximately 250 meters, connecting the two highest points in MacRitchie — Bukit Peirce and Bukit Kalang ... about a 4.5km walk from the main MacRitchie Reservoir Park entrance at Lornie Road (about 1-2 hours depending on how fast you walk). It's part of the 11-kilometer MacRitchie Nature Trail.

claim: Long-tailed macaques along the MacRitchie trail are fearless; visitors should not feed them, scream, or use flash photography.
quote: MacRitchie Reservoir's macaques are quite fearless, so it's important to use common sense and follow park regulations to not antagonise them (don't feed them, don't scream at them, don't use flash photography).

claim: Henderson Waves is Singapore's tallest pedestrian bridge, a 274m undulating span with seven curved 'ribs' that double as shelters and alcoves.
quote: The iconic Henderson Waves is a distinct 274m-long pedestrian bridge with a unique wave-like structure, and is the tallest pedestrian bridge in Singapore. A series of seven undulating "ribs" double up as alcoves and provide shelter to park users looking for rest.

claim: The Southern Ridges is a 10km trail linking four parks; both routes start at HarbourFront MRT Exit D and take 3–5 hours; Henderson Waves is LED-lit nightly 19:00–02:00.
quote: Both route A and B start at Harbourfront MRT station Exit D ... Both routes take an estimated 3-5 hours to complete ... admire how attractive it looks when lit up with LED lights from 7pm to 2am daily.

claim: The Pulau Ubin bumboat from Changi Point costs SGD 4 per person (cash, plus SGD 4 surcharge for a bicycle), runs 06:00–19:00 daily, departs when 9–12 passengers board, and crosses in about 15 minutes.
quote: The Pulau Ubin ferry costs S$4 per person per trip, and you pay the boat operator directly in cash ... The bumboats run from 6am to 7pm daily, and they don't have a fixed schedule. They leave whenever there are 9 to 12 passengers on board ... The boat ride takes about 15 minutes

claim: Pulau Ubin's standout sights include Chek Jawa Wetlands boardwalks, Puaka Hill summit, Butterfly Hill, Ketam Mountain Bike Park, and cycle rentals around SGD 15–25 per day.
quote: At the top of the list of must-see attractions on Pulau Ubin are the Chek Jawa Wetlands ... hiking to the summit of Puaka Hill ... Ketam Mountain Bike Park ... The rental fee varies but a typical cost is around S$15-25 for a full day

claim: Sungei Buloh Wetland Reserve hosts migratory shorebirds from August to April, including Whimbrels, Common Greenshanks, Pacific Golden Plovers and Lesser Sand Plovers; over 200 bird species have been recorded.
quote: During migratory season from August to April, catch sight of flocks of Whimbrels, Common Greenshanks, Common Redshanks, Pacific Golden Plovers ... Over 200 species of birds have been spotted at the Sungei Buloh Wetland Reserve

claim: Sungei Buloh Wetland Reserve is free to enter, open daily 07:00–19:00 with last entry 18:00, and covers more than 200 hectares of mangrove habitat along the East Asian–Australasian Flyway.
quote: The reserve operates daily from 7 AM to 7 PM, with last entry at 6 PM ... spanning over 200 hectares of mangrove habitat and serving as a vital stopover for migratory birds along the East Asian-Australasian Flyway.

claim: Bukit Timah Nature Reserve is open daily 07:00–19:00 and offers multiple trails up Singapore's 163m natural summit; the main red trail to the top takes 30–45 minutes.
quote: The hike to the summit takes 30 to 45 minutes via the red trail at a regular walking pace, with the descent taking 20 to 30 minutes ... The reserve is open from 7:00 AM to 7:00 PM daily.

claim: Coney Island Park is open 07:00–19:00 (gates close at 19:00), has West and East entrances, no on-island carparks, and a 2.5km park connector ideal for cycling; visitors should avoid feeding monkeys.
quote: The park operates from 7am to 7pm (gates will be closed at 7pm). You can enter the park via 2 entrances: the West entrance (near Punggol Point Walk and Punggol Promenade) or the East entrance (near Lorong Halus Wetland) ... Cycle along the 2.5km Coney Island Park Connector

claim: Coney Island has recorded more than 80 species of resident and migratory birds and features the Casuarina Exploration playground; visitors are warned about sandflies and should bring water as there are no food facilities on-island.
quote: More than 80 species of resident and migratory birds have been spotted at this park ... Wear long pants and covered shoes for protection from insects such as sandflies. Once you get on to Coney Island itself, there aren't any facilities for food
